conviction_note: The quarter's main line (CARVYKTI ~$710m) was pre-released on 13 Oct and revenue consensus (~$360m, one source) already looks ex-milestone, so what is left is the profit line, which loses Q2's one-off $56m milestone and was guided to a lower-50s gross margin; the first call under a new CEO (US sales flat q/q at $472m before the 23 Dec anito-cel PDUFA); and a +35%/20d run-up with no company catalyst big enough to explain it, against short interest of ~7% and 6.7 days to cover. That gives p_up 45 on abs 7 (= -0.7) against a findings sum of -1.6; the gap is that each negative is small and inference-heavy, the EPS bar is disputed ($0.01 vs $0.16), and the run-up could just as easily be positioning for a constructive first call from the new CEO.
bar: Revenue ~$359.9m for Q3 2026 (one aggregator, six estimates, surfaced via search; not two agreeing sources). EPS bar disputed: Benzinga non-GAAP $0.01 vs MarketBeat $0.16 (2 estimates), https://www.benzinga.com/quote/LEGN/earnings-forecasts and https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/legend-biotech-nasdaqlegn-announces-earnings-results-2026-08-11 . The company's own frame is a pre-release, not a guide: CARVYKTI net trade sales ~$710m (6-K 2026-10-13, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1801198/000117184326006593/f6k_101326.htm), plus gross margin on product sales guided to lower-50s% for Q3 and mid-50s for Q4 (Q2 call per Quartr, single source, https://quartr.com/events/legend-biotech-legn-q2-2026_FGK9FYtC). My estimate is collaboration revenue ~$352m (50% of US $472m + ~49% of ex-US $238m) plus ~$5-10m license/other, so ~$357-362m, about on the bar. Because the bar is unsourced to two agreeing sources, every finding is capped small.
positioning_check: Short interest 13.9m shares as of 2026-10-15 settlement, 6.7 days to cover, 193.8m shares outstanding (~7%), per https://massive.com/quote/legn (page snapshot 2026-11-06). That is down from 16.39m / 7.1 days at the 2026-09-30 settlement (https://massive.com/quote/legn, earlier snapshot cited via search). So some covering has already happened, but the short is still moderately crowded. Skew: not available, because the baseline chain is unusable (ATM spread 148% of mid). ATM IV is 82.6% at 11 days against 54% realised vol, which hints at an event premium of roughly 10% one-sigma, but the quotes are too wide to trust. Put/call OI is 0.3, so call-heavy. Tape: +14.0% over 5 days and +35.1% over 20 days into the print, still 33.7% below the 52-week high.

findings.finding: Q2 2026 total revenue of $387.5m included $56.0m of Janssen milestones (EU commercialization approvals in three major countries), which do not recur. With CARVYKTI at $710m, Q3 collaboration revenue is ~$352m and total revenue ~$357-362m, down sequentially from $387.5m, and adjusted net income falls well below Q2's $63.1m. The bar of ~$359.9m appears to already exclude the milestone.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (11 Aug) revenue $387.5m vs ~$356-358m consensus, an ~8% beat partly from the milestone, and the stock gained ~6% (https://primexbt.com/news/legend-biotech-gains-6-after-q2-revenue-beat-and-first-profitable-quarter/). The baseline's history is from non-earnings 6-Ks and is not used.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the revenue consensus (~$359.9m) already sits below Q2's $387.5m, which is what it would look like if analysts stripped the milestone. What is not resolved is the EPS bar: the $0.01 and $0.16 estimates differ by 16x, so headline screens could print 'revenue down q/q' and 'EPS miss' against whichever figure a terminal shows.
findings.independence: Same Q2 6-K as the tax finding (different line). Q1 6-K shows license/other revenue was only $6.7m in Q1 2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001801198/000180119826000014/a991earningsreleaseq12026.htm), which confirms the Q2 jump was a one-off.

findings.finding: J&J's Q3 2026 supplementary sales table puts CARVYKTI US sales at $472m, exactly flat with Q2 2026 US ($472.0m per Legend's Q2 reconciliation), after $433m in Q1 (9M US $1,377m). All sequential growth came from ex-US ($185m to $238m, +29% q/q). This lands on the call's Q4/2027 US-demand commentary ahead of anito-cel's 23 Dec 2026 PDUFA.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The figure became public on 13 Oct (Legend pre-release, stock +0.45% that day per baseline 6-K row) and 14 Oct (J&J table). The stock then rose ~35% over 20 sessions, so the market has so far looked through it.
findings.why_not_priced: The total ($710m, +35% y/y, +8% q/q) is what the wire carried. The US/ex-US split sits only in J&J's PDF table and Legend's Q2 reconciliation. If the market had priced US stagnation into a looming BCMA CAR-T competitor, the stock would not have run +35% into the print. J&J's call attributed growth to 'share gains across earlier lines of therapy and continued site expansion' and said nothing on US q/q, so management will be asked.
findings.independence: Legend Q2 6-K US $472.0m (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/LEGN/legend-biotech-reports-second-quarter-2026-results-and-recent-nmtqxxtdcdgw.html). Anito-cel PDUFA 23 Dec 2026 (https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260427408690/en/gilead-sciences-completes-acquisition-of-arcellx-ahead-of-potential-commercial-launch-of-anito-cel/). Net of the rest: ex-US +29% q/q offsets on total sales, and Legend books ~50% of both, so the finding is about US trajectory and competitive narrative, not the reported number.

findings.finding: Management guided gross margin on net product sales to the lower-50% range for Q3 (from 58% in Q2 and 41% in Q1), rebounding to the mid-50s in Q4. With no milestone, Q3 gross profit on ~$352m collaboration revenue is ~$180-185m against ~$190m in Q2, so operating profit sits near breakeven before adjustments. The guide frames this as expected.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 gross margin dropped to 41% from 57% and the stock still gained after the Q1 print (https://www.barchart.com/story/news/1904509/legend-biotech-q1-earnings-call-highlights). Q2's 58% was paired with a +6% reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: This is inside the company's own guide, so it is mostly priced. The only unpriced part is whether the lower-50s guide holds or slips, and the Q4 mid-50s reiteration. Single-source wording.
findings.independence: Q2 cost of collaboration revenue $136.0m on $326.1m (=58.3%), per the Q2 release (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/LEGN/legend-biotech-reports-second-quarter-2026-results-and-recent-nmtqxxtdcdgw.html), consistent with the 58% figure. Shares the profit-line theme with the milestone finding but is a different fact.

findings.finding: This is the first earnings call under CEO Ingrid Zhang (ex-Novartis international CCO, effective 15 Sep 2026; predecessor Ying Huang left abruptly 24 Jul, stock -13% that day). It opens the way to a strategic re-framing, pipeline reprioritisation or a first 2027 outlook, with sign unknown. New-CEO first calls lean to expectation resets.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior Legend print under a new permanent CEO. The 27 Jul CEO-departure day fell 13% (https://www.biocentury.com/article/660301/ceos-departing-legend-sarepta).
findings.why_not_priced: The market knows the CEO changed but has not heard her outlook. If a reset were priced, the stock would not have run +35% in 20 days, and some commentary (Stocktwits) frames her hire as buyout-friendly, which is the opposite read. Inference only.
findings.independence: none (inference about new-CEO behaviour; no document)

findings.finding: The pipeline newsflow since the last print is positive and dated: FDA cleared the IND for LB2501 (in vivo CD19/CD20 CAR-T) on 15 Oct, and ASH 2026 abstracts released 4 Nov show 100% ORR/CR in 8 patients at dose level 2 plus CARTITUDE-4 data with ~60% progression-free at 30 months in len/dara-refractory patients. The call can add US Phase 1/2 timing and in vivo strategy.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: June 2026 LB2501 proof-of-concept: +42% in a day. 15 Oct IND: +3.99%. 4 Nov ASH abstracts: +6.01% (baseline 6-K rows on those dates, which are pipeline releases, not prints).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: both releases moved the stock on the day and drove part of the run-up. What remains is what the call adds, such as the US trial start and any partnering talk.

findings.finding: The stock goes into the print +35.1% over 20 sessions and +14.0% over 5, off an October low of ~$17.56. The headline sales number has been public since 13 Oct, so the stock rose into a print whose revenue line was already known. Short interest is 13.9m shares (~7%, 6.7 days to cover, 15 Oct), down from 16.4m on 30 Sep.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 print, after a smaller run-in, gained ~6%. No sourced instance of this name's reaction after a 30%+ run-in.
findings.why_not_priced: The run-up is the price. The question is whether it already holds a good call. With the main line pre-released and the profit line set to look weaker q/q (no milestone, lower GM), the asymmetry leans to sell-the-news. The partly crowded short (6.7 days) is a squeeze mechanism, which is why this is small.
findings.independence: Tape figures from the sealed baseline (run_up_20d_pct 35.14, run_up_5d_pct 14.0). Oct prices from AAII (https://www.aaii.com/investingideas/article/552643-why-legend-biotech-corporation8217s-legn-stock-is-up-870), with no catalyst named for late-October moves.

findings.finding: The Q2 tax charge jumped to $22.3m (from $0.6m) on taxable profit in the US, Belgium and China. The company warned that its unsigned China advance pricing agreement 'may result in a tax liability that is materially different from that reflected in the consolidated financial statements', so a tax true-up is a possible below-the-line surprise in Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior tax surprise found for this name.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a risk-factor sentence, not a quantified item, so nobody can model it. Below operating income, with no path to guidance unless it changes the steady-state tax rate.
findings.independence: Same Q2 release as the milestone finding (different line).
